chapter: La Cigalle and settling in Paris
title: Passing on a Paris studio, then buying one; plans to return home
summary: Waters could have bought a cheap studio near the Cigalle but still planned to return to America. A woman and steady jobs kept him in Paris, though he considered buying a house for his niece.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Can I have a chance? (PS laughs) Why - I had a chance to come back and I had, I could have bought a little studio right up the street right around the corner from La Cigalle for two million, which is very, very cheap.
That was when the inflation was in -
Yeah -
Yeah, the franc -
A million - oh man, that's nothing, two millions francs, old francs too -
Benny Waters JOHP 6/6/82
Yeah, that's what I'm saying, the inflated franc -
That's nothing, that's nothing, you know what I mean? So -
Be somethin' now, but it wasn't then.

Yeah, yeah, I mean the thing, it went up, the thing went up four times within a year or so. Anyway - and I didn't buy it because I had an idea of going back home, you know? So, what - then that kept me there, you know, see the little, you know, see - so then after I got established, then I just - then I bought apartment, I have an apartment there, see, I've -

got an apartment, see, a studio. So now I'm pretty well - well, I still be comin' back one of these days, settling, come back, you know -

You know how you have to give the guy, the laywer first a little money to go through the deeds and thing.

I was gonna buy the house two years ago. Then I changed my mind, see. Because I found out that, look, my niece is a little bit [ ] there with this deal, she had a fair chance that she didn't want to - the way it looked I wouldn't be able to be actually at my house -
Uh huh -
That she has an adopted kid, and this kid was on dope and a whole lot of stuff, you know. With all that I changed -
Uh huh -
Changed my mind.
